title: Our Future Health — POCT lipid profile data — warning checks
description: Non-blocking checks for the poct_lipid_profile table, from rules the source does not state but the steward accepted (D129). A finding is a warning for analysts and data providers: it never rejects a row and never changes data. Run tools/warn.py; the main schema and tools/validate.py are unaffected.

allOf.$comment: Warning R190: the first set of POCT lipid measurements was skipped but SECOND_READING_SKIPPED is not -998; only participants with abnormal first readings are offered a second set, so a participant with no first readings should not have one.
